caption: "wnba playoffs" — 5,000,000+ searches this week. The first playoffs under the new pay deal.

Why: The playoffs began September 27. On September 29 the No. 8 Liberty swept the No. 1 Lynx, a first in WNBA history, and Caitlin Clark had the first 25-point, 15-assist game in WNBA history. A title now pays $60,000 per player, up from $22,908 last year.

What most people don't know: all 8 playoff teams split about $1.44 million in bonuses, at 12 players a team. That is about one player's top salary this year, $1.4 million. NBA playoff teams split $35.7 million.
Very simply put: the whole playoffs cost about one max contract.
